name: Norpipanone
summary: Norpipanone (INN, BAN; Hexalgon) is an opioid analgesic related to methadone which was developed in Germany and distributed in Hungary, Argentina, and other countries. It had originally not been under international control but upon observation of case reports of addiction it was reviewed and shortly thereafter became a controlled substance.

pharmacology.en: It acts as an agonist at the μ-opioid receptor, as methadone does, and belongs to the same open chain group of opioids.
pharmacology.zh: 它和美沙酮一樣是 μ 型鴉片受體的促效劑，屬於同一類開鏈結構的鴉片藥物。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它和美沙酮一样是 μ 型鸦片受体的促效剂，属于同一类开链结构的鸦片药物。

uses.en: It was used as a painkiller. It is little used today.
uses.zh: 它曾作為止痛藥使用，現今已很少使用。
uses.zhHans: 它曾作为止痛药使用，现今已很少使用。

sideEffects.en: Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether.
sideEffects.zh: 它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。

fact.en: It was developed in Germany and sold as Hexalgon, and for a while was not controlled in some countries because it fell outside the wording of the drug laws of the time.
fact.zh: 它在德國研發並以 Hexalgon 的商品名販售，有一段時間在某些國家未受管制，因為它不符合當時藥物法規的文字定義。
fact.zhHans: 它在德国研发并以 Hexalgon 的商品名贩售，有一段时间在某些国家未受管制，因为它不符合当时药物法规的文本定义。
